explication: This is a Spark DataSource V2 connector for reading from and writing to ClickHouse across Spark 3.3–4.2. The principal workflow starts with Spark’s provider/catalog integration, proceeds through a read scan or write task, and exchanges data with ClickHouse through the shared client layer. The tree also shows schema/engine handling, expression and partition translation, and telemetry. The graph uses the sampled Spark 3.3 implementation for shared connector stages; source excerpts and the index support only some internal call relationships, so other links are left unverified.
